page.layout: One column of running text, with marginal notes in the left margin. A cut-off strip of the neighbouring right-hand page shows at the far right edge and is not transcribed.

main_text.l: tatem compressurae sunt etiam si ad ali-
mus[?]) in malis quae tunc fiebant, quasi
quit, arma spiritualia, non opus jaculis
& sagittis? &c. Sed quid interim de hoc
do, aut deponendo, ne verbum quidem,
mandato profugere coactus, in eos qui
inquit, nubecula est, breui euanescet.] Quasi dix-
isset; non ipsi eam dissoluite, sed ejus
duas quidem Invectivas in eum scripsit

page.notes: Cut-off right-hand page at the edge: only fragments of lines are visible, so it is not transcribed. Running head at top right reads LIB.III, not included in running_head. Note b reads "Serm. in Iuventinum & Maximum tom.3."; the marker letters in the text are at "Charysostomus" (b), "Athanasium" (c) and the bracketed passage (d). Doubtful readings: "Charysostomus" (print: Charyfostomus), "euenturam" (print looks like cuenturam). "Lyberius" and "Athanasium" are kept as printed. Left margin notes are in italic type where printed. The footnote marker d sits inside the bracketed passage and the margin note carries the same letter.
